paper_tile.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game UI asset: one seamless square paper FILL texture, no edges or objects. Reference image is ONLY the chosen pale blush-pink and rose-cream hand-painted paper style, not its layout, typography, or background. Generate a square 1024x1024 opaque texture that fills every pixel to all four edges. Pale warm rose-cream base approximately #ead1c8 with delicate irregular dry-brush strokes of blush #d9b6af and warm ivory #f4e4d6. Visible short tapered painterly bristle marks in loose interleaved directions, restrained contrast with broad calm areas for text. It must be a genuinely seamlessly tileable material in both x and y: paint shapes continue across opposite edges; no vignette, no overall light gradient, no border, no isolated large feature that repeats conspicuously. Flat illustrated pigment, not photographed paper fibers, no bump lighting or paper thickness. Avoid green, sage, olive, teal; keep warm PINK. No text, no shadows, no framing, no noise-only or blurry water stain texture. Full opaque square, no transparent pixels.

No borders, no shapes, no text, no transparency, no UI arrangement. Absolutely NO green/sage/olive/teal.

paper_border.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE independently generated game UI asset, a hollow 9-slice paper BORDER on 透明背景 / true transparent background. Image1 is locked approved pink parchment style and natural minor wear; Image2 is the separately made foreground fill texture you must match. Do NOT reproduce the whole reference layout. Generate one SQUARE cream-blush paper rim, viewed dead flat front-on, centered with a clean large transparent rectangular hole in the middle. Canvas 1024x1024. Outer paper shape approximately x64..960,y64..960, each edge basically straight but with delicate short relaxed waving and tiny worn notches, subtle imperfect corners. Inner transparent hole approximately x210..814,y210..814, feather only a narrow few pixels on its inner edge to blend over the independent fill; wide enough fully opaque rim. This is a thin flat paper sheet frame, NOT a picture frame / wood / raised object. Rim coloration pale warm PINK #ead1c8, restrained visible bristle marks matching Image2. One very thin broken warm ivory ink outline inset about 55px from outer edge, modest turned corners like selected concept, no ornaments or motifs. Edges halfway along each side have matching level, width, color and stroke flow so straight edge segments can repeat seamlessly; corners fit their adjacent horizontal and vertical edge strips. Must have fully transparent pixels outside and INSIDE central hole. No other sheets, no drop shadows, no text, no name tabs, no buttons, no background checkerboard painted in. Avoid green or yellow cast, thick folds, regular sawteeth, large dents/protrusions, shiny beveled lines. Preserve soft tiny paper wear. One asset only.
